Name: Well of Sirah
Description: A well near Hebron from which Joab's men brought Abner back after Abner had left David in peace, to the place where Joab killed him.
BiblicalSignificance: Sirah's well is where Abner was brought back to his death at Hebron.
RelatedPeople: Abner, Son of Ner; Joab, Son of Zeruiah
